name: Quay
summary: Quẩy is the fried breadstick Hanoi eats with most noodles. Dip it in the broth.
origin: Hanoi, on Vietnam Tourism’s ten-dish list, in the miến note.
howToEat: Dip the breadstick in the noodle broth. Vietnam Tourism’s ten-dish list says most Hanoi noodles take quẩy, and miến is one of them.
where: With the noodle bowls, including miến at 6 Phùng Hưng, Hoàn Kiếm.
seoDescription: Quẩy in Hanoi is the fried breadstick Vietnam Tourism says to dip in noodle broth, including miến at 6 Phùng Hưng.
